description: The Tell Chapel stands on a rock ledge at the shore of Lake Uri in Sisikon, a small pale building with a pitched roof and the cliff behind it. The windows stay dark, so the interior frescoes are not shown, and there is no statue. This replaces the Altdorf Tell monument, already published. The Open-Meteo model is clear and mild, about 17°C, with cloud cover near one-fifth, a breeze, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
